if(game.clubboxPropUnlocked(element:parent().propInd) == true) then component("spriteName"):SetString(game.clubboxPropCustomizeIcon(element:parent().propInd)) component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/"..game.clubboxPropCustomizeSheet(element:parent().propInd)) else component("spriteName"):SetString("button_empty") component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/clubbox_customization_volume.xml") end

touchComponent.event:
local perfSlider = element:parent() if perfSlider then local clubPerfEdBg = perfSlider:parent() if clubPerfEdBg then local clubPerfEd = clubPerfEdBg:parent() if clubPerfEd then if element:parent().propInd == game.getDJHoolaPropInd() then clubPerfEd:setOptionsView() return end
if clubPerfEd.CostumeView then clubPerfEd.CostumeView.selectedPropInd = element:parent().propInd clubPerfEd.CostumeView:selectProp() end end end end

element.event:
element.Sprite("visible"):SetInt(1)
-- turn touch on?
-- am I the dj prop? local isDJ = element:parent().propInd == game.getDJHoolaPropInd()
local numVariants = game.clubboxNumVariantsInProp(element:parent().propInd, false)
if element:parent()("disabled"):GetInt() == 0 and (numVariants > 0 or isDJ) then element:parent().EditIcon:setVisible() element.Touch("enabled"):SetInt(1) if element:parent().OptionsIcon then element:parent().OptionsIcon:setVisible() end else element:parent().EditIcon:setInvisible() element.Touch("enabled"):SetInt(0) end
element.Sprite("visible"):SetInt(0) element.Touch("enabled"):SetInt(0) element:parent().EditIcon:setInvisible() if element:parent().OptionsIcon then element:parent().OptionsIcon:setInvisible() end

element.name: EditIcon
element.event: if(element:parent().propInd ~= -1 and (game.clubboxPropUnlocked(element:parent().propInd) == true)) then element.Sprite("visible"):SetInt(1) end

element.name: SliderBg
element.event: --4 situations: -- locked entities (with instrument) will have no volume bar visible: -- unlocked entities (with instrument) will have volume bar visible -- unlocked entities with no track will have X volume bar visible (with fg set to volume 0) -- entries that have no associated prop will have X volume bar visible (with fg set to volume 0) if(element:parent():parent().propInd == -1 or (game.clubboxPropUnlocked(element:parent():parent().propInd) == true)) then element.bg("visible"):SetInt(1) element.fg("visible"):SetInt(1) end if(element:parent():parent()("disabled"):GetInt() == 0) then element.Touch("enabled"):SetInt(1) end

spriteSheetComponent.name: bg
spriteSheetComponent.event: if(element:parent():parent().propInd ~= -1 and game.hasAudioTrack(element:parent():parent().propInd)==true) then component("spriteName"):SetString("volume_slider_lower") else component("spriteName"):SetString("volume_slider_none") end component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/clubbox_customization_volume.xml") component("size"):SetFloat(0.4*(screenHeight()/320)) component("layer"):SetString("MidPopUps") component("visible"):SetInt(0)

element("FullMaskH"):SetInt(component("maskHeight"):GetInt()) element("FullMaskW"):SetInt(component("maskWidth"):GetInt())
local vol = game.clubboxPropVolume(element:parent():parent().propInd) if(component("isSourceRotated"):GetInt() == 0) then component("maskHeight"):SetFloat(element("FullMaskH"):GetInt() * (1.0 - vol)) else component("maskWidth"):SetFloat(element("FullMaskW"):GetInt() * (1.0 - vol)) end

local slidingHeight = element:absH() --local clampedRelY = clamp(relY, 0, slidingHeight) component.vol = (1.0 - relY / slidingHeight) game.setClubboxPropVolume(element:parent():parent().propInd, component.vol) component.vol = game.clubboxPropVolume(element:parent():parent().propInd)
